in_sanskrit.name: अरिजित
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Arijit' is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ari' (conqueror, enemy) and 'jit' (conquered, victorious). It suggests one who conquers enemies and is unconquerable.

in_hindi.name: अरिजित
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Arijit' in Hindi is translated as 'Vijayi', which means victorious or conquering.

in_tamil.name: அறிஜித்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name 'Arijit' in Tamil is 'Aṟijit', which means 'one who leads to the temple (of God) or is revered like a temple'.

in_telugu.name: అరిజిత్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name 'Arijit' in Telugu is 'Arijiṭa', which means 'invincible or unconquerable'.

in_marathi.name: Arijit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Conqueror of sorrows
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arijit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arijit is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'ari' meaning ruler or conqueror and 'jit' meaning victory. In Hindu mythology, Arijit is the name of a king, a warrior or a deity who conquers sorrows and brings happiness and prosperity.
